rain_bed.prompt: Heavy steady rain falling on a wide river and on old wooden planks, close and immersive, no thunder, no music, no voices

water_lap.prompt: Calm river water gently lapping against the wooden hull of a small boat, soft drips, a bamboo pole slowly pushing through water, peaceful, no music

crow_caw.prompt: A single large crow cawing twice, harsh and close, outdoors in light rain

wings.prompt: A large crow suddenly taking off, three heavy wing flaps, close

step_puddle.prompt: One straw sandal stepping into a shallow muddy puddle, a single wet splash, close

steps_mud.prompt: Slow heavy footsteps of one man in straw sandals walking on a wet muddy path in the rain, one step every 0.7 seconds

steps_wood.prompt: Slow footsteps of one person walking on wet wooden dock planks, soft creaking boards, rain

pipe_tap.prompt: Two sharp taps of a small metal tobacco pipe bowl knocked against a wooden post

sword_draw.prompt: A long katana drawn slowly from its wooden scabbard, a clean ringing metallic shing

pole_plant.prompt: A long bamboo pole planted firmly on a wooden dock, one solid hollow wooden thud

clash.prompt: A single sword strike: a steel blade shattering against a thin blade, a bright metallic crack and ringing shards falling

blade_thunk.prompt: A broken sword blade falling and stabbing point-first into a wooden plank, a sharp thunk and a short metallic quiver

kneel.prompt: A man dropping heavily to his knees on wet wooden planks, cloth rustling

whoosh.prompt: One fast heavy sword swing whoosh through rain

thunder.prompt: A long distant thunder rumble rolling slowly across mountains in heavy rain

morning.prompt: A calm wide river just after rain at sunrise, slow drips from leaves, a few distant birds, a soft breeze, peaceful, no music

wind_gust.prompt: A single cold gust of wind sweeping through rain, rising and falling

boat_creak.prompt: A small wooden boat creaking as a person steps into it, water knocking against the hull

bell.prompt: A single small Japanese temple singing bowl struck once, a pure high ringing tone that rings out for a long time

heartbeat.prompt: Two slow deep human heartbeats, close and muffled
